title: Five-generation Montgomery-Harrington family
goal: A reader can trace five generations while reading each person's full given and family name.

rubric.must: The drawing contains five distinct ancestral rows, from Christopher and Eleanor at the top to Sophia and Henry at the bottom.
A visible chain of parent-child connections runs from Christopher and Eleanor through Jonathan, Daniel, Alexander, and Sophia and Henry.
All displayed labels show full given and family names and remain readable without overlapping another label or symbol.
Jonathan Theodore Montgomery and Claire Annabelle Montgomery visibly descend from the Christopher-Eleanor partnership.

Daniel Christopher Montgomery and Julian Sebastian Montgomery share one sibship line under Jonathan and Margaret, while Alexander James Montgomery and Lydia Margaret Montgomery share the next under Daniel and Beatrice.
Partnership and descent lines are visually separate from the long person labels and do not cross through symbols.

ideal.notes: Five evenly pitched Montgomery generations preserve every full given and family name, with each sibship centred beneath its own couple and Sophia identified by a teal double outline. Birth years remain visible for everyone.
